changelog:
[B][COLOR ff00fa9a]Version 2.0.13[/COLOR][/B]
[COLOR fffdb515]Sync credentials with your devices[/COLOR]
-Paired devices can now pass your credentials to each other over your home network, so a new Kodi is set up in a minute instead of typing every key again. It has its own menu in Tools and at the end of Settings > Accounts, apart from Premiere TV Shows and Premiere Movies, with pairing included: the same pairing serves all of them, so devices already paired can send credentials straight away.
-On the device that needs them, choose Receive credentials: it waits for five minutes. On the device that has them, choose Send credentials, pick the device and tick what to send from the list.
-The list only shows what this device has: AllDebrid, TorBox, Easynews and the DMM key; Torz, Comet, MediaFusion, Sootio, Meteor, AIOStreams, Newznab and Orion with their instance; OpenSubtitles; your TMDb, Fanart.tv, TheTVDB, OMDb and TheIntroDB keys and your TMDb account; your Gemini keys; and the API keys of the YouTube add-on.
-The receiving device shows what arrived and whether it is new or replaces what it has, and saves only what you leave ticked.
-Only keys and logins that do not expire travel this way. Trakt, SIMKL, MDBList, PunchPlay, WeTrakr, Real-Debrid and Premiumize use an OAuth sign-in, so each device keeps signing in on its own.
-Nothing leaves your network: credentials go only to a device you paired with a PIN, encrypted, and are never written to the log.
[COLOR fffdb515]Sync windows[/COLOR]
-Sync credentials with your devices and Sync your devices in Premiere TV Shows and Premiere Movies now open in the same side panel as the context menu, with the device name and address in the header and where you are under it.
-Show a PIN on this device shows the PIN in large figures with a bar and the time left. Receive credentials shows the name to choose on the other device while it waits. Cancel or Back stops waiting.
-Credentials are listed by kind (Debrid, Scrapers, Subtitles, Metadata and ratings, Natural search, Trailers), each kind under a title with its own icon, with a tick on each row and Select all. Pairing has its own title too. The first row sends or saves and says how many are ticked.
-Back goes one step back, to the menu you came from; Home goes to the luc_kodi main menu. After renaming the device or unpairing one, the menu opens again with the change.
-With Context menu style set to Classic (Kodi menu), Kodi's own windows are used, as before. They are also used if the panel cannot open.
[COLOR fffdb515]Premiere Movies[/COLOR]
-New Premiere Movies, the same idea as the Premiere Lists for TV shows: lists you name yourself where you keep films that are not out in digital yet. It is in Movies > Release Calendar, under New on Digital, and in Library.
-Add a film with Add to Premiere Movies... from its context menu. It is offered on films not released yet or released in cinemas within the last year.
-The date that counts is the digital release (rent, buy or streaming), because until then there is nothing to play. It is the US digital date, as in New on Digital; if the US has none, the first one anywhere. The cinema date is shown as information.
-Same rules as the TV shows: a film without a digital date or more than 90 days away waits for its date, and one within 90 days counts down. Dates are checked again on TMDb every 12 hours.
-You get a notice the day before and on the day, and when the date is confirmed or moved. On release day the film goes into your movie library, with the 24-hour delay if you use it, and leaves the list a week later.
-A film already out in digital is not added and says since when.
-The Premiere Lists for TV shows are now called Premiere TV Shows, with Add to Premiere TV Shows... in the context menu. Nothing else changes.
-Sync your devices shares Premiere Movies too. Devices with an older luc_kodi keep syncing TV shows only and never receive films.
[COLOR fffdb515]Usenet with TorBox Pro[/COLOR]
-TorBox has shut down the search service that TorBox Search (Usenet) relied on, so that scraper could only ever return nothing, Pro plan or not. It has been removed, with its switch and its options in Settings > Accounts > TorBox. TorBox for torrents and its account settings are unchanged.
-Usenet with TorBox Pro now goes through your own indexer: the Newznab scraper can have its NZBs downloaded by TorBox Pro as well as by Premiumize. Choose it in Settings > Providers > Newznab > Download NZBs with: Automatic (Premiumize if enabled, otherwise TorBox Pro), Premiumize or TorBox (Pro plan).
-luc_kodi asks TorBox whether NZBs are already on its servers, leaving your indexer key out of that check, and marks them as cached usenet: those play straight away. The others are shown as usenet and TorBox fetches them from Usenet when you pick one, with a window showing progress, speed and time left.
-Cancelling, a failed download or one that does not advance for the time set in Give up if the NZB download does not advance removes it from your TorBox account, so nothing is left half-downloaded. Only one NZB is fetched at a time.
-Usenet is only part of TorBox Pro: with Essential or Standard, Newznab results are not sent to TorBox and the log says why. The plan is checked once every 6 hours.
-The Newznab Setup Wizard now says which service will download your NZBs.
[COLOR fffdb515]Easynews[/COLOR]
-With Search API Version 3.0, Easynews Search came back empty: that version names its fields differently (extension, runtime) and luc_kodi only read the 2.0 names, so every file Easynews sent was dropped without a word in the log.
-Both versions are now read, also when Easynews sends files as lists, with the extension with or without its dot and the size as text.
-With debug logging on, each search says how many files Easynews sent, how many were kept and why the rest were left out (sample, extension, other title, language, size).
-When Easynews answers with nothing at all, which the 2.0 API does when more than two searches run at once on an account, luc_kodi tries once more and says so in the log.
[COLOR fffdb515]Peerflix[/COLOR]
-Peerflix is now a source of releases from Spain: every release it serves has Castellano audio (from Wolfmax4K, DonTorrent, MejorTorrent, BitSearch and others), and asked for English it answers with nothing for almost every title, which is why it came back empty with the old default English setting. luc_kodi asks it for Spanish, in one request.
-Its Audio setting has two clear choices instead of three: Only those with English audio too (dual audio: MULTI, DUAL, ES-EN, Castellano-Ingles, Cast-Ing), the default, or All (Castellano, with or without English). The two old choices with Spanish already did the same; whoever had either one keeps All.
-Every Peerflix result shows PEERFLIX as its provider. The name shown before was the site Peerflix took the torrent from (PEERFLIX, PEERFLIXBOT, BITSEARCH, DONTORRENT, GRANTORRENT...), which split one scraper into names nobody could tell apart. The sites are still listed in the debug log.
-Its releases carry the Spanish title, often without a year (Mad Max Furia en la carretera [4K UHDremux][2160p], Gladiator II BDrip XviD Castellano), which never matched the English title. As Peerflix is searched by IMDb id, a release now counts unless it names another year, which still keeps out the odd wrong film Peerflix mixes in. Measured on Peerflix's answers of 21 October, with the old Spanish choice (now All): Gladiator II 10 of 10 kept (was 1) and Mad Max: Fury Road 21 of 22 (was 2). With the old default, which asked in English and got nothing, the dual-audio setting now keeps 2 and 13.
-The list shows Peerflix's descriptive line (Mad Max Fury Road [4K UHD 2160p HEVC X265][AC3 5.1 Castellano+Subs][ES-EN]) instead of cryptic file names, and takes the resolution from Peerflix's own label when the release does not say it.
-With All in its setting, Peerflix's releases are no longer removed by Remove identified Foreign single audio sources: asking for Castellano audio is the point of that choice.
-When addon.peerflix.mov does not answer, its static copy on peerflix.mov is asked the way it understands (without the settings in the address, which it answered with an error), and Exclude Quality is applied by luc_kodi too.
-Min Seeders says to leave it at 0: many cached releases show 0 seeders.
-The provider test checks Peerflix's host too (Host: OK instead of --).
-Quality, size and language are read from the right place, and the request uses Peerflix's current address first.
[COLOR fffdb515]Scrapers[/COLOR]
-Zilean asks the midnightignite instance first: ElfHosted's answered 404 to every search. ElfHosted stays as a fallback.
-Torz without a config token falls back to another public StremThru instance when the chosen one does not answer (ElfHosted's public API now answers 403), and leaves the failing one aside for 6 hours. With a config token it stays on its own instance.
-A full Blu-ray disc (.m2ts files) found on TorBox is skipped with a warning in the log instead of an error, and removed from your TorBox account, and the next source plays.
-AIOStreams switched off no longer writes a warning about its missing URL when the provider test runs it.
-A site that does not answer in time, refuses the request (403, 404, 5xx) or cannot be reached is now a one-line WARNING in the log instead of an ERROR: it is the site, not luc_kodi. Errors in luc_kodi's own code are still ERROR.
[COLOR fffdb515]Provider test[/COLOR]
-A provider that chooses not to search now shows SKIPPED with the reason instead of EMPTY.
-A scraper that is switched off now says so under its line: "Scraper not active. Please enable it in Settings > Providers.", or "enable and configure it" when it also lacks its key or account. TorBox's and Easynews' point to their place in Accounts.
-The Cfg column now also checks Easynews, Newznab and Orion, which need an account or a key.
-When a scraper comes back with 0 because its site failed, the provider test and System status say so: "torrentio.strem.fun did not answer in time. The site is slow or busy right now: try again later.", or which code it answered. Torrentio's Spanish trackers did that in 2 of 12 searches on 21 October.
[COLOR fffdb515]Settings[/COLOR]
-The shortcuts that open the settings on a section (My Accounts, Library, Subtitles, Providers...) land on it again on Kodi 21 and later: Kodi 21 renumbered the section buttons, so they all opened on General, and opening the settings wrote "Control -100 in window 10140 has been asked to focus, but it can't" to the log.
-Some shortcuts pointed at the wrong section since sections were added: AllDebrid's authorization opens Accounts, OpenSubtitles' Subtitles and the language invoker Debugging.
[COLOR fffdb515]Log[/COLOR]
-An error line from a failed request no longer shows the API key in the address (your personal TMDb key travels as ?api_key=): it is written as <REDACTED>, as the scrapers' lines already were.
